summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable), so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment. Order worker stalled in a wait state (heartbeat age ~95s), leaving the queue to back up (420 queued); the deeper cause of the stall is not determined.
recommended: Verify payments-v2 provider endpoint before retrying the migration
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on worker heartbeat age
Investigate why the worker entered a wait state

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5

I'm seeing two problems here: the provider URL is pointing to an unreachable v2 endpoint, and the worker is stuck with a 94s heartbeat. I should fix the config first by reverting to v1, then restart the worker and reprocess.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
